integrity: The infinite statement is proved structurally. Exhaustive finite verification is used only as a stress test and does not substitute for the proof.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is for ordinary distance-one liar domination on connected complete multipartite graphs of order at least three.
Complete-bipartite scalar liar-domination values are prior work and are not claimed as new.
The primary full text of Roden and Slater (2009) was not available in the inspected lawful sources; later full-text literature explicitly reports its complete-bipartite scalar results.
title: All liar's dominating sets of complete multipartite graphs
